entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
FINALLY! I've been trying to return this helmet I bought and your website is useless. I want this handled right now or I'm lighting you up on social media.
I can certainly help you look into a return. I just need to ask a few questions first. To clarify, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Are you serious? The issue is the color is absolutely not what I wanted. It's hideous. I want my money back. Don't you dare try to give me the runaround.
I understand your frustration with the color. To process anything, I'll need to pull up your order information. Do you have your order number available?

Yes, it's VF-998241. And you better believe I'll be leaving a review about this. A visible helmet is a critical safety feature, and this color is dangerously dull. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
Thank you for that, one moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered about 71 days ago. Is that correct?
I don't know, maybe. Are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager? I've been a customer for years, this is outrageous.
That won't be necessary, sir. I see that your purchase is still well within our 90-day standard return policy. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh. Well, fine. That's what I expected. So what's next?

I've just initiated the return in our system and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. You just need to print it, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any courier. Once our warehouse receives the unopened box, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days.
Okay. A prepaid label. Good. That's fine then.
Great. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
